summary.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). What you built and how, in a few sentences.

sanity.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). build/lint/run result summary (counts + verdicts, not full logs).

notes.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). Anything else; if detail overflows, write it to a $TMPDIR file and name the path here.

tested.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). What you exercised — the suites/checks added or run and what they cover.

coverage.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). coverage figure + notable gaps (code), or validation summary (non-code).

items.description: exact repro + location — the failing assertion/command, not a full log paste

ci.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). CI/e2e or other automated-pipeline result, if run.

what.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). the problem + fix, described — not a diff

test_assessment.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). Is the test suite adequate? Gaps the test-engineer should close.

plan_feedback.description: Concise prose only — NO code, diffs, or file contents (those are on disk). spec/plan corrections for the orchestrator.
